data_boundary: attempt-2 development captures only; no attempt-2 held-out capture entered candidate extraction or selection
rejection_reason: Each rejected family lost states, tied or lost to a causal baseline in at least one leave-one-development-trial-out fold, or both.

selected_candidate.name: unlabeled_trial_calibrated_log_spectrum
selected_candidate.calibration: featurewise center and standardize using the four unlabeled calibration observations in the same trial, floor each standard deviation at 0.30, then unit-normalize each observation

noise_context_post_hoc.interpretation: Low acoustic margin may contribute to trial shift, but this audit does not establish causality and does not change playback gain or geometry.

fresh_run_justification: The selected candidate beat every causal baseline in every leave-one-development-trial-out fold by more than 0.20 while keeping all four states occupied. It alone advances to fresh-seed confirmation.
claim_boundary: This is spent-data design evidence only. It cannot promote H2.
